deck.name: Phrase Deck Special Cards
deck.description: Optional effect cards that alter phrase playback or bar length without replacing musical note cards.

cards.name: Repeat Phrase
cards.rule: Place after a completed phrase. Play the entire phrase before this card one additional time, in the same order.

cards.name: Tie
cards.rule: Place between cards when the final note on the left and first note on the right are the same pitch. Sustain it across the boundary.

cards.name: Two Four
cards.rule: Set each bar to 2 beats for this phrase. Fill every bar exactly before beginning the next.

cards.name: Three Four
cards.rule: Set each bar to 3 beats for this phrase. Fill every bar exactly before beginning the next.

cards.name: Four Four
cards.rule: Set each bar to 4 beats for this phrase. Fill every bar exactly before beginning the next.
